acceptance_criteria.criterion: Slug is displayed in the metadata card with a pencil edit button
Clicking the pencil reveals an inline input pre-filled with the current slug
Invalid slug patterns are rejected client-side with an inline error (no API call made)
Successful slug rename navigates the SPA to #/projects/{newSlug}
The detail page reloads correctly at the new slug URL after navigation
API errors are surfaced as inline messages below the input

summary: Added renameSlug API method to the API client object in app.js
Added slug display row with pencil edit button to the metadata card HTML

Implemented inline slug edit IIFE (patterned on title edit): pre-fill, client-side /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/ validation, error display, double-save guard (inputDone), loading/disabled state, success navigation to #/projects/{newSlug}, API error surfacing
Added CSS: grouped .edit-slug-btn with .edit-title-btn via selector grouping; added .slug-edit-input and .slug-edit-error classes

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent with the existing title-edit pattern.

summary: All 8 acceptance criteria verified against app.js and styles.css implementation.
SLUG_REGEX /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/ correctly mirrors SAFE_SLUG_REGEX from constants.ts.
Client-side validation short-circuits before API call on invalid slug — confirmed no API.renameSlug() invocation path is reachable without passing regex and same-slug checks.
inputDone guard verified: flag set before doSlugSave() in both Enter and blur handlers; reset to false only on validation failure or API error to permit retry.
Loading/disabled state applied to input during API call; re-enabled on API error.
Slug widget placed in .card metadata section only — NOT in the h1 heading area, satisfying the layout constraint.
escapeHtml(slug) used when rendering slug value — XSS-safe.
All 1107 existing server-side tests pass (36 test files, 0 failures, 0 regressions).

metrics.test_coverage: server-side tools/storage/utils — GUI JS not unit-tested (no JS test framework present)

comments.note: When Enter is pressed on an invalid slug, inputDone resets to false; a subsequent blur will call doSlugSave() again, re-showing the same validation error. This is a minor UX quirk but not a bug — the error message is idempotent and no data corruption or double API call occurs.

GUI JavaScript (app.js) has no automated unit/integration tests. Edge-case verification was performed by static code inspection only. The inline slug edit IIFE is a close copy of the title edit IIFE, which reduces novel risk.

summary: Reviewed app.js (inline slug edit IIFE) and styles.css. Implementation is correct, consistent with the existing title-edit pattern, and meets all 8 acceptance criteria.
SLUG_REGEX /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/ mirrors the server-side SAFE_SLUG_REGEX exactly — no divergence.
inputDone guard logic is correctly placed in both the Enter keydown handler and blur handler, preventing double-save.
Error element is created lazily using both an id (slug-edit-error) and className (slug-edit-error), satisfying the AC and enabling idempotent re-rendering.
Hash navigation uses encodeURIComponent(newSlug) — XSS-safe. Slug value rendered with escapeHtml(slug) — also safe.

CSS is minimal and idiomatic: .edit-slug-btn grouped with .edit-title-btn (DRY); .slug-edit-input uses monospace font appropriate for identifiers; .slug-edit-error uses the shared --color-blocked variable consistent with title-edit-error.
exitSlugEdit() correctly restores slugValueEl and editBtn visibility and removes the input from DOM — no orphan nodes on cancel or Escape.
One low-priority debt item noted: no maxLength attribute on the slug input; 200-char cap is enforced server-side only. Not a blocking issue.

comments.note: app.js slug input has no maxLength attribute; the 200-character cap is only enforced server-side. Adding maxLength='200' to the created input element would give immediate client-side feedback and bring parity with the server constraint at negligible cost.
No blocking observations — code is architecturally sound, consistent with existing patterns, and all documented edge cases are handled correctly.

summary: Applied code-review improvement: added input.maxLength = 200 to the slug edit input in app.js, matching the server-side 200-char cap (SAFE_SLUG_REGEX + storage validation).

Added v1.9.3 changelog entry to mcp-server/changelog.md covering WP-002 (API layer: RenameBodySchema extension, conflict() helper, 7 new tests, 1100 total passing) and WP-003 (GUI: inline slug edit widget, maxLength, CSS classes, SPA navigation, client-side validation).
Noted the same-slug no-op → 500 known limitation in the changelog (deferred per code-review guidance).
No other documentation gaps identified — api-surface.md was comprehensively updated by WP-001 and WP-002 pipelines; JSDoc on renameSlug() and updateTitle() was addressed in WP-001 documentation.

comments.note: app.js slug input: added input.maxLength = 200 per code-review suggestion, giving immediate client-side byte-cap feedback to match the server-side constraint.

Same-slug no-op → 500 edge case documented in v1.9.3 changelog as a known limitation. The fix (pre-check newSlug === slug or widen CONFLICT catch prefix) is straightforward and should be addressed in a follow-up WP.
